incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Production inference 5xx spike in us-west1 — high customer impact. Affected route: /v1/generate. Paging oncall: @Ava (oncall). Incident key: INF-17925. Please join bridge if available: zoom.us/j/placeholder

Ava (oncall): I'm on it. Joining the bridge now. Can someone paste the quick hit runbook link? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Dina (eng-runtime): Runbook: https://redwood.io/runbooks/inference-5xx. Initial quick checks: node health, recent deploys, autoscaler logs, kv-cache stats. I'm tailing the logs.

Carlos (sre): Noted. I'm grabbing kube events + prometheus graphs for token error rate and p95 latency. Will upload snapshots to the bridge.

BenJ (product): Heads-up — support flagged a customer (Acme Inc.) with 30% request failures. Need an impact short blurb for status page.

Elaine (comm): I'll draft a short statuspage entry once we have confirmed scope and ETA. Who can confirm if this is global or single region?

Dina (eng-runtime): Early signal points to us-west1 only. Error pattern: auth success -> request enters runtime -> 5xx from model-serving container. Looking at container logs:

```
2026-03-15T15:07:12Z runtime[worker-12]: POST /v1/generate -> 200ms
2026-03-15T15:07:13Z runtime[worker-12]: model-infer: kv-cache miss
2026-03-15T15:07:14Z runtime[worker-12]: model-infer: kernel-load ERROR: mismatched-kernel-version
2026-03-15T15:07:14Z runtime[worker-12]: 500 InternalServerError: kernel mismatch
```

Ava (oncall): Interesting — kernel mismatch. Any recent rolling deploys or kernel upgrades at ~15:05?

infra-build-bot: Deploy event: commit 6a7f2c -> rolled to us-west1 at 2026-03-15T15:04:58Z (canary then full). No rollbacks yet.

Carlos (sre): Timeline (prelim):
- 15:03:10 UTC: canary deploy started in us-west1
- 15:04:58 UTC: canary -> promoted to full region
- 15:06:30 UTC: error rate begins to increase (5xx spike)
- 15:07:14 UTC: first kernel mismatch logged (worker-12)
- 15:12:00 UTC: autoscaler reaction (scale-up events)

BenJ (product): So deploy correlates tightly. If confirmed, this is a deploy regression. Need rollback or model fallback ASAP.

Dina (eng-runtime): I can force a model variant fallback for traffic to older runtime image (image:v2.3) with compatible kernels. Doing a staged rollback on a single node first. Command I'm running: 

```
kubectl set image deploy/model-runtime model-runtime=registry/redwood/model-runtime:v2.3 -n prod-us-west1 --record
```

Ava (oncall): Good. While that's running, can someone snapshot affected request IDs and examples for RCA? We need logs per request for eval.

Dina (eng-runtime): Pushing request samples to /shared/incidents/INF-17925/samples.log (1.2MB) — includes stack traces and kernel versions.

Carlos (sre): Hypotheses (tracked in-thread):
- H1: New runtime image introduced kernel ABI change -> mismatch with precompiled kernels -> immediate 5xx for hot requests. (evidence: kernel mismatch error in logs + deploy timeline)
- H2: KV-cache eviction race after deploy causing load spike -> kernel loader triggered unexpectedly -> errors. (evidence: kv-cache miss logs prior to kernel errors)
- H3: Autoscaler overload: the scale up created many cold nodes without preloaded kernels -> concurrent kernel loads exceed memory -> failures. (evidence: scale events at 15:12)

Ava (oncall): We're running the staged rollback now. If rollback reduces 5xx then H1 gains weight. If not, we'll probe H2/H3.

infra-build-bot: Rollback job started at 2026-03-15T15:16:02Z for model-runtime -> image:v2.3. Progress: 3/12 pods updated.

BenJ (product): For status page: draft one-line -> "We are investigating an elevated rate of 500 errors affecting text generation requests in the us-west1 region. Some customers may see increased request failures. Engineers are actively mitigating." Need ETA estimate?

Elaine (comm): Draft 1.0 (please react with :+1: to approve):
- Impact: Some customers in us-west1 may see increased failure rates for /v1/generate.
- Status: Mitigation in progress — rollback and traffic routing.
- Next update: in 30 minutes or sooner.

Ava (oncall): :+1: Approve draft. Add note to contact support if customer outage > 10 minutes.

Dina (eng-runtime): Rollback complete at 15:21:05Z. Post-rollback logs show kernel loads succeeded and 5xx rate declined. Quick perf check: p95 latency stable.

Carlos (sre): Monitoring: error rate back to baseline by 15:24 UTC. Confirming with graphs now.

BenJ (product): Confirming Acme Inc. — failure rate reduced to <1% after 15:25. I'll notify support channel to update customer.

Elaine (comm): Statuspage v1 posted (internal draft):
"We experienced elevated 500 errors for text generation in the us-west1 region between ~15:06–15:24 UTC. Mitigation: rollback to previous runtime image resolved the issue. Root cause: under investigation."

Ava (oncall): Ok moving to RCA coordination. Who will own RCA write-up? I'd like eng-runtime + SRE to co-author. I'll add timeline + mitigation notes.

Dina (eng-runtime): I'll own root-cause investigation. Plan: reproduce locally with the new image, capture kernel loader telemetry, and test cold-start kernel load behaviour under concurrency.

Carlos (sre): I'll own timeline + metrics appendix and coordinate on alert tuning to detect kernel-mismatch earlier.

Ava (oncall): Handoff notes for the next oncall (if needed):
- Incident ID: INF-17925
- Summary: Deploy introduced kernel mismatch errors causing 5xx for /v1/generate in us-west1. Rollback to v2.3 restored service.
- Actions taken: staged rollback, sample collection, status page draft posted, customers notified.
- Open tasks: reproduce locally (Dina), RCA doc (Dina + Carlos), alert rule to detect kernel-mismatch (Carlos), postmortem timeline and customer impact quant (Ava/BenJ).

Elaine (comm): Stakeholder comms plan:
- Immediate: status page + support update (done)
- 2 hours: internal exec summary (1-2 paragraphs) — I'll draft and ask for EM sign-off
- 24 hours: public postmortem with technical findings and mitigation steps

BenJ (product): I'll gather customer impact metrics (list of impacted customers, duration, request volume) and paste into /shared/incidents/INF-17925/impact.csv

Dina (eng-runtime): Quick reproducibility note: I can reproduce kernel mismatch when new image loads kernels compiled with kernel-abi v3 while runtime expects v2. Testing a fix: ensure kernel compatibility build flag or ship precompiled kernels with image.

Carlos (sre): Recommendation for immediate prevention: add a preflight check during deploy that validates kernel ABI compatibility on a canary pod before promoting region-wide. I'll file an infra ticket.

Ava (oncall): Thanks everyone. Logging this as resolved for paging. If anything regresses or new data appears, ping INF-17925 and reopen. I'll start the initial postmortem template and assign tasks.

incident-bot: Incident INF-17925 status changed to RESOLVED by Ava (oncall) at 2026-03-15T15:48:00Z. Postmortem link placeholder: https://redwood.io/incidents/INF-17925/postmortem

Elaine (comm): Drafted exec summary (please review):
"At ~15:06 UTC on 2026-03-15, a production deploy caused a kernel compatibility issue in the inference runtime in us-west1, leading to elevated 500 errors for text generation requests. Engineers rolled back the runtime image and restored service by ~15:24 UTC. We are investigating a long-term fix and will publish a detailed postmortem."

Ava (oncall): :white_check_mark: I'll review the postmortem draft and assign follow-ups in the incident board. Good job team.

Dina (eng-runtime): Uploading final artifacts (logs, samples, graphs) to /shared/incidents/INF-17925/artifacts.zip

Carlos (sre): Filed infra ticket: INF-17925-1 — deploy preflight kernel-abi check. Ticket: https://redwood.io/tickets/INF-17925-1

BenJ (product): Support notified customers and provided mitigation notes. Closing loop with Acme.

Elaine (comm): I'll schedule exec update at 17:00 UTC. Thanks all.

Ava (oncall): Handoff complete. Next oncall: @Dina (on in 1 hour) — see open tasks in incident board.
